name: Overload Voidbound Deposits
tooltip:
Overload Voidbound Deposits
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Introduce more entropy to an already fragile deposit, creating a catastrophic reaction where reality collapses in on itself. Chunks of ore materialize nearby, enabling particularly quick miners to gain additional materials.

There is also a fracture in reality left behind--who knows where you'll end up if you step through it?

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
